'''Adranax''' was a famous [[Korfani]] [[Poet/Legends|poet]]. One of their more famous verses was:<ref name="Flame in Need">{{WEGCite|story=An Old Flame in Need...|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>
:"Why mourn for tomorrow in tears today
:When current fleeting hours not long shall stay?
:Come stroll with me, we shall find your lost peace
:In an old friend's arms and a gentle kiss."<ref name="Flame in Need" />
